overview: More than 35 fossils from the White Sea region preserve a bilateral, soft-bodied animal with a broad foot-like area and a non-mineralized cover on its back. The sample lets researchers reconstruct a distinctive body plan; it does not settle whether Kimberella belongs within crown Mollusca.
overviewZh: 白海地区 35 件以上化石保存了一种两侧对称的软体动物：身体下方有宽阔、近似足部的区域，背面覆盖物没有矿化。样本足以帮助重建独特的身体结构，但还不能确定 Kimberella 是否属于冠群软体动物。

ecology.diet: A surface-feeding interpretation is inferred from the body form and associated traces. No radula is preserved, so the feeding mechanism remains unknown.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from a shallow-marine seafloor in the White Sea region. This is a sampled setting, not a map of the animal’s full geographic range.
ecology.locomotion: The broad foot-like region is consistent with crawling across the seafloor, but the movement itself is inferred from preserved anatomy.
ecology.bodySize: The fossils represent a centimetre-scale soft-bodied animal; the available description does not define a broader size range.
ecology.guild: A mobile benthic feeder is a reconstruction based on the body plan and associated traces, not a preserved behavior or direct gut-content record.
ecology.bodySizeZh: 化石记录的是厘米级软体动物；现有描述没有界定更广的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 对其为可移动的底栖摄食者的重建，依据是身体构型和相关遗迹；化石没有保存这种行为，也没有直接的胃内容物记录。

traits: The fossil bodies are bilaterally organized, with a recognizable front-to-back axis.
A broad, foot-like ventral region is central to the proposed crawling reconstruction.
The dorsal cover was non-mineralized, so the fossil preserves its outline and impressions rather than a shell of hard plates.
evidenceSummary: The White Sea sample supports a reconstruction of body form and likely seafloor activity. It preserves no radula, does not establish membership in crown Mollusca or direct ancestry, and cannot stand for a complete geographic range.
evidenceSummaryZh: 白海样本支持对身体结构和可能海底活动方式的重建。化石没有保存齿舌，不能确定其属于冠群软体动物或是现生类群的直接祖先，也不能代表完整的地理分布。

readerLimitations.en: The White Sea sample preserves body form, but no radula. Crawling and surface feeding are reconstructions from anatomy and associated traces; the fossils do not establish crown-Mollusca membership, direct ancestry or the full species range.
readerLimitations.zh: 白海样本保存了身体轮廓，却没有齿舌。爬行和表层摄食是根据解剖与相关痕迹作出的复原；这些化石不能确定其属于冠群软体动物、构成直系祖先或代表完整物种分布。

traitsZh: 化石个体呈两侧对称的体制，前后轴清晰可辨。
宽阔、似足的腹侧区域，是拟议爬行方式重建的关键依据。
背侧覆盖物未矿化，因此化石保存的是其轮廓和印痕，而非由坚硬板片构成的壳。

commonNameZh: 布尔吉斯页岩齿谜虫样本
overview: Across 189 specimens, transverse tooth rows, a broad foot and mantle-groove structures recur. Whether the rows are homologous to a molluscan radula remains an interpretation.

ecology.diet: A benthic feeding role is inferred from the tooth rows and body plan; the fossils do not preserve a meal.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the marine Burgess Shale seafloor.
ecology.locomotion: Crawling is inferred from the broad foot, not directly observed.
ecology.bodySize: The soft-bodied animal is centimetre-scale; no more precise size estimate is given here.
ecology.guild: A mobile benthic feeder is an anatomical inference.
ecology.dietZh: 根据齿列和身体构造推测其在海底取食；化石没有保存具体食物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自海相布尔吉斯页岩海底沉积。
ecology.locomotionZh: 宽大的足部支持其可能爬行的解释，但并非直接观察结果。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 这种软体动物体长为厘米尺度；这里没有更精确的体型估计。
ecology.guildZh: 依据身体构造推测其为能移动的底栖取食者。

traits: Paired transverse tooth rows are preserved.
The tooth rows show posterior replacement.
A broad foot and mantle-groove structures recur in the sample.
evidenceSummary: Repeated preservation supports the anatomical observations. Radula homology and phylogenetic placement remain interpretations rather than direct observations.
overviewZh: 在 189 件标本中，横向排列的齿列、宽大的足部和外套沟结构反复出现。齿列是否与软体动物齿舌同源，仍是解释。
traitsZh: 化石保存有成对的横向齿列。
齿列显示出向后替换的现象。
样本反复保存宽足部和外套沟结构。
evidenceSummaryZh: 反复出现的标本支持这些解剖观察。齿列与齿舌的同源关系及系统位置仍属解释，并非直接观察。

overview: Ninety newly prepared specimens preserve paired eyes, two tentacles, lateral fins and a funnel-like structure. The study interprets Nectocaris as a cephalopod, but that placement remains contested.

ecology.diet: Predation is inferred from the eyes and tentacles; prey and feeding behavior are not directly observed.
ecology.habitat: The marine water column is inferred from the fins and funnel-like structure rather than directly recorded.
ecology.locomotion: Swimming is inferred from the lateral fins and funnel-like anatomy; the fossil does not record performance.
ecology.bodySize: The described material is centimetre-scale and soft-bodied; a broader size range is not established here.
ecology.guild: Calling Nectocaris a free-swimming predator is a functional interpretation, not a directly observed role.
ecology.bodySizeZh: 所述材料为厘米级软体动物；这里没有确定更广的体型范围。

traits: Paired camera-like eyes
Two frontal tentacles
Lateral fins and ventral funnel-like structure
evidenceSummary: The repeated preservation of soft anatomy does not resolve the placement. The cited study reports no diagnostic shell, siphuncle, beak or radula, so cephalopod affinity remains contested.

title.zh: 软躯体标本保存了什么

text.en: The study describes 90 specimens with paired eyes, two tentacles, lateral fins and a ventral funnel-like structure. The authors interpret the anatomy as that of a swimming, predatory cephalopod. Because the specimens lack a diagnostic shell, siphuncle, beak or radula, the classification remains disputed; swimming and predation are interpretations rather than directly observed behavior.
text.zh: 研究描述了 90 件标本，保存有成对的眼、两条触手、侧鳍和腹侧漏斗状结构。作者把这些解剖特征解释为游泳、捕食型头足类。由于标本没有诊断性的壳、体管、喙或齿舌，这一分类仍有争议；游泳与捕食是解释，不是直接观察到的行为。

title.en: Primitive soft-bodied cephalopods from the Cambrian
title.zh: Primitive soft-bodied cephalopods from the Cambrian

scope.en: Recorded reader-passage locators: supports; pages: 469–472; Figures 1–4; Supplementary Information
scope.zh: 读者段落的原始定位：supports; pages: 469–472; Figures 1–4; Supplementary Information

commonNameZh: 晚阿特达班期小米克里纳虫骨片组合样本
overview: Micrina is represented by separated hard plates, not an articulated animal. Sellate plates preserve paired muscle scars; projections on mitral plates are interpreted as muscle platforms. Together they support a testable reconstruction of a sessile, two-valved body, but the proposed articulation and valve homology are not preserved.

ecology.diet: The isolated plates do not record diet or feeding mode.
ecology.habitat: The reconstructed animal is sessile in a marine carbonate setting; attachment and habitat are interpretations, not direct observations of a living animal.
ecology.locomotion: The proposed body plan is sessile. The fossils do not preserve observed movement.
ecology.bodySize: The preserved phosphatic plates are millimetre-scale; the reconstructed animal's full size is not established.
ecology.guild: An attached seafloor life is inferred from the reconstruction, not directly observed.
ecology.dietZh: 这些孤立的壳板没有记录食性或摄食方式。
ecology.habitatZh: 重建结果显示该动物固着生活于海相碳酸盐环境中；附着方式和栖息环境属于解释，并非对活体的直接观察。
ecology.locomotionZh: 提出的身体构型为固着型；化石没有保存可观察到的运动。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 保存下来的磷酸盐壳板为毫米级；重建动物的整体大小尚未确定。
ecology.guildZh: 根据重建结果推断其附着于海底生活，并非直接观察所得。

traits: Mitral phosphatic sclerites with apophyses interpreted as muscle platforms
Sellate phosphatic sclerites with paired muscle scars
Near-bilateral bivalved reconstruction
evidenceSummary: The study covers four localities in three broadly synchronous late Atdabanian carbonate units, including the Wilkawillina Limestone of South Australia. The 521–514.5 Ma interval is a conservative envelope for that sample, not a global genus range or a brachiopod origin date. Muscle platforms, whole-body assembly, valve homology and stem-brachiopod placement remain interpretations.

title.en: How the plates support a reconstruction
title.zh: 骨片如何支持体制复原

text.en: The fossil record contains separate mitral and sellate sclerites. Paired muscle scars are visible on the sellate plates; the mitral projections are interpreted as muscle platforms. Researchers assembled the pieces into a near-bilateral, sessile animal with two valves. That model is testable, but no fossil preserves the proposed valves joined together, and their homology or a position on the brachiopod stem remains a comparative hypothesis.
text.zh: 化石中分离保存着 mitral 与 sellate 两类骨片。sellate 骨片上可见成对肌痕；mitral 骨片的突起被解释为肌肉平台。研究者据此把骨片组合为近两侧对称、固着生活的双瓣动物。这个模型可检验，但没有化石直接保存相连的两片壳瓣；壳瓣同源性及其腕足动物干群位置仍是比较假说。

title.en: Four localities bound this study sample
title.zh: 四个地点限定了这组研究材料

text.en: The material comes from four localities in three broadly synchronous late Atdabanian carbonate units. One named locality is the Wilkawillina Limestone in the Arrowie Basin, South Australia. The conservative 521–514.5 Ma envelope is tied to these studied units; it is not the genus's full duration, a place of origin, or a sequence of direct ancestors.
text.zh: 研究材料来自三个大致同期的晚阿特达班期碳酸盐岩单元中的四个地点，其中一处是澳大利亚南部 Arrowie 盆地的 Wilkawillina 石灰岩。521–514.5 Ma 是这些研究层位的保守年代包络，不是该属的完整延限、起源地点或直系祖先序列。

title.en: The Early Cambrian tommotiid Micrina, a sessile bivalved stem group brachiopod
title.zh: The Early Cambrian tommotiid Micrina, a sessile bivalved stem group brachiopod

commonNameZh: 澄江管状触手冠动物样本
overview: No single Yuganotheca fossil shows the whole animal. The reconstruction brings together 710 fossils referred to Yuganotheca elegans from the Yu’anshan Member at Chengjiang: paired valves built from grains, a lophophore, a two-part tube and a pedicle. That combination is useful for comparing forms near the brachiopod–phoronid stem, but it does not settle the homology of each structure or identify an ancestor.
overviewZh: 没有一件 Yuganotheca 化石展示了完整身体。研究把澄江玉案山段归入 Yuganotheca elegans 的 710 件化石合在一起复原：成对壳瓣由颗粒黏结而成，样本还分别保存触手冠、两段式管状结构和肉茎。这组特征可用于比较腕足动物—帚虫动物干群附近的形态，却不能确定每个结构的同源关系或祖先身份。

ecology.diet: The preserved lophophore supports a suspension-feeding interpretation; feeding itself is not observed.
ecology.habitat: The fossils come from the marine Chengjiang depositional setting.
ecology.locomotion: The pedicle suggests attachment, but the fossils do not record movement.
ecology.bodySize: The reconstructed tubular body is measured on the millimetre scale.
ecology.guild: Suspension feeding is inferred from the reconstructed anatomy, not established for every fossil.
ecology.habitatZh: 化石来自海相澄江沉积环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 肉茎暗示其附着生活，但化石没有记录移动情况。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 重建的管状身体以毫米为尺度进行测量。
ecology.guildZh: 根据重建的解剖结构推断其悬浮摄食，但不能将这一结论套用于每件化石。

traits: Paired grain-built valves surround a chamber for the lophophore.
The tube is divided into two parts by a median collar.
A long pedicle is preserved; its internal space is interpreted as coelomic.
evidenceSummary: Read together, the Chengjiang fossils supply the anatomy and formal stratigraphic context, but not a complete body in one specimen. Whether the valves and tube match structures in other groups, and where Yuganotheca belongs near the brachiopod–phoronid stem, depend on comparative interpretation and the tree tested. The sample is not a global range or proof of direct ancestry.
evidenceSummaryZh: 合看澄江样本，才能得到相应解剖和正式地层背景；没有单件化石保存完整身体。壳瓣和管状结构是否与其他类群的结构同源，以及 Yuganotheca 在腕足动物—帚虫动物干群附近的位置，都取决于比较解释与所检验的树。本样本不代表全球分布，也不证明直系祖先关系。

readerLimitations.en: The body plan is reconstructed across referred fossils rather than from one complete specimen. Suspension feeding and attachment are functional interpretations; structural homology and the precise brachiopod–phoronid stem position remain interpretive, not evidence of direct ancestry.
readerLimitations.zh: 身体结构是由归入样本综合复原的，并非来自一件完整化石。悬浮摄食与附着属于功能解释；结构同源和腕足动物—帚虫动物干群中的精确位置仍有解释空间，不能据此认定直系祖先关系。

traitsZh: 一对由颗粒构成的壳瓣围绕着容纳腕肢的腔室。
中部领状结构将管分为两部分。
保存有一条长柄；其内部空间被解释为体腔。

commonNameZh: 寒武纪波杰塔贝壳样本
overview: More than fifty Pojetaia runnegari shell specimens from probably Botomian Ajax Limestone and lowermost Botomian Erkeket Formation preserve a laminar inner fabric comparable to foliated aragonite; the paper does not identify undisputed Cambrian nacre.

ecology.diet: Feeding mode is not directly preserved; shell microstructure does not identify diet
ecology.habitat: Shallow-marine Cambrian carbonate setting inferred from the sampled formations
ecology.locomotion: Not directly observable from shell sections
ecology.bodySize: Millimetre-scale shell material; whole-animal size is not established here
ecology.guild: Ecological guild is unresolved from isolated shell sections

traits: Laminar inner shell microstructure
Foliated-aragonite comparison
More than fifty studied shell specimens
evidenceSummary: Shell sections directly document the sampled laminar fabric; comparison to foliated aragonite and any precursor relationship to nacre remain interpretive, and the sample is not a global bivalve range or ancestor claim.

title.en: A shell interior, not an animal in full
title.zh: 贝壳内部结构，不是完整动物

text.en: The cited study examines more than fifty Pojetaia specimens, including shell sections from South Australia. Those sections preserve a layered inner fabric that the authors compare with foliated aragonite. They discuss how the material bears on the history of nacre, but do not claim undisputed Cambrian nacre in these specimens. Shell sections reveal structure; they do not preserve this animal's feeding or movement.
text.zh: 所引研究检查了 50 多件 Pojetaia 标本，包括来自南澳大利亚的贝壳切片。切片保存了层状内织构，作者将其与叶片状霰石作比较。论文讨论这些材料对珍珠层演化史的意义，但没有声称这些标本已无争议地保存寒武纪珍珠层。贝壳切片能显示结构，却不能保存该动物如何摄食或运动。

title.en: A regional sample with a bounded age
title.zh: 有界的区域样本与年代范围

text.en: The paper places the sampled shells in the Ajax Limestone and the lowermost Erkeket Formation of South Australia. Their correlations are described as probably Botomian and lowermost Botomian, respectively. Using the Cambrian Stage 4 boundaries in the International Chronostratigraphic Chart v2026/06 gives a 514.5–506.5-million-year sample envelope. It is a dated window for the cited material, not a complete global first or last appearance for the species or genus.
text.zh: 论文将所研究的贝壳置于南澳大利亚的 Ajax 石灰岩和 Erkeket 组最下部。两处地层的对比分别被表述为“可能属于 Botomian”和“最下部 Botomian”。按照《国际年代地层表》v2026/06 的寒武纪第 4 期界线，所引材料的样本年代包络为 5.145–5.065 亿年前。这只是该批材料的年代窗口，并非该物种或属的完整全球首现或末现。

title.zh: 贝壳证据无法回答什么

text.en: The shell material supports a species-level account of the studied specimens and a comparison of their mineralized layers. Isolated sections do not establish whole-animal size, diet, locomotion or ecological role. The higher evolutionary position of early bivalves and any relationship to later nacre remain comparative questions, not evidence that Pojetaia was a direct ancestor of living bivalves.
text.zh: 这些材料支持对所研究标本作物种级记录，并比较其矿化层。孤立切片不能确定完整动物的体型、食性、运动方式或生态角色。早期双壳类的更高阶演化位置以及它们与后来的珍珠层之间的关系仍是比较研究问题；这并不证明 Pojetaia 是现生双壳类的直接祖先。

title.en: Vendrasco et al. (2011), Pojetaia shell microstructure
title.zh: Vendrasco 等（2011），Pojetaia 贝壳微结构

scope.en: The paper documents Pojetaia shell sections and their inner laminar fabrics. Its comparison with foliated aragonite and discussion of nacre evolution are interpretations tied to the examined material, not a direct record of feeding or a complete bivalve history.
scope.zh: 该论文记录 Pojetaia 贝壳切片及其层状内织构。与叶片状霰石的比较和有关珍珠层演化的讨论都限于所检材料，是解释而非摄食行为或双壳类完整演化史的直接记录。

scope.en: The v2026/06 chart supplies numerical boundaries for the named Cambrian interval. It bounds the cited shell sample under its qualified Botomian correlations; it does not turn that regional sample into a global first or last appearance.
scope.zh: v2026/06 年代地层表为所用寒武纪时段提供数值界线。它依据带有限定语的 Botomian 对比界定所引贝壳样本的年代范围，并不会将区域样本转化为全球首现或末现。

overview: Articulated Kutorgina chengjiangensis fossils from the Chengjiang Lagerstätte preserve paired valves alongside a lophophore, digestive tract and pedicle. This formation-scale sample makes early brachiopod anatomy unusually tangible, while feeding function and ancestry remain interpretations.

ecology.diet: Suspension feeding inferred from the preserved lophophore
ecology.locomotion: Pedicle attachment inferred from the preserved pedicle; movement is not observed
ecology.guild: Sessile suspension feeder is inferred from lophophore and pedicle anatomy

traits: Articulated calcareous valves
Early spirolophe lophophore
Digestive tract and pedicle
evidenceSummary: The Chengjiang material preserves valves and associated soft anatomy. The lophophore and pedicle support an attached, suspension-feeding interpretation, but behavior is inferred and this local sample does not establish the origin or full range of Brachiopoda.

title.en: A feeding organ is preserved with the valves
title.zh: 壳瓣旁还保存了摄食器官

text.en: The described specimens preserve paired calcareous valves with an associated lophophore, digestive tract and pedicle. A lophophore is the tentacle-bearing organ used by brachiopods in suspension feeding; the described form has an early spirolophe arrangement. The fossils let researchers compare this soft anatomy with the shell, while attachment and feeding remain functional interpretations rather than behavior observed in life.
text.zh: 描述的标本保存了成对钙质壳瓣，以及与之相连的腕冠、消化道和肉茎。腕冠是腕足动物用于悬浮摄食、带有触手的器官；该化石呈现一种早期螺旋腕冠形态。化石让研究者能把软组织结构与壳瓣放在一起比较，但固着方式和摄食仍属功能解释，并非对活体行为的直接观察。

title.en: One Chengjiang sample is not an ancestor ladder
title.zh: 澄江的一组材料不是祖先序列

text.en: The material comes from the Chengjiang Lagerstätte in Yunnan, South China, within an Early Cambrian study window of about 520–518 Ma. It records a particular species and formation, not the complete geographic range of that species or the global first appearance of brachiopods. The anatomy can inform comparisons among early body plans without making Kutorgina a direct ancestor of later brachiopods.
text.zh: 这组材料来自中国云南南部的澄江生物群，研究所用的寒武纪早期年代窗口约为 520–518 Ma。它记录的是一个特定物种和地层，不是该物种的完整地理分布，也不是腕足动物在全球的首现时间。其解剖结构可用于比较早期体制，但不能据此把顾脱贝视为后世腕足动物的直接祖先。
